note: A 5.1 km square terrain aperture south of El Reno airport with the clipped original NWS Damage Assessment Toolkit polygon identified as ElReno_Poly (31 May 2013). Orange marks mapped damage-survey coverage on unexaggerated USGS 3DEP terrain. Public USDA NAIP aerial imagery supplies later geographic context, not a photograph of the tornado or its 2013 damage; the catalog tile at the aperture center is dated 29 May 2021. The full polygon is pinned, but its longer eastward track lies outside this deliberately local aperture. The polygon is not an instantaneous funnel, a measured wind-field surface, or an exact outline of the published maximum 2.6-mile tornado width. No vortex, funnel, moving centerline or artificial width boundary is constructed. The polygon source retains its historical EF3+ attribute; this does not revise the NWS event rating. No crop walls, underside, stand, independent ruler or schematic geometry is included.
